image:image.image:title: Industrial buildings and a power plant along the South Branch of the Chicago River at dusk, with the downtown Chicago skyline behind them.
image:image.image:caption: Industrial corridor on the South Branch of the Chicago River, with the Loop beyond.

image:image.image:title: Interior of a high-bay warehouse with tall pallet racking, skylights, and forklifts moving palletized goods.
image:image.image:caption: Warehouse interior with selective pallet racking: clear height, column spacing, lighting, and floor condition all affect how a building works.

image:image.image:title: Aerial view of rows of single-story industrial and warehouse buildings with truck courts and parking in Elk Grove Village, Illinois.
image:image.image:caption: Small- and mid-bay industrial buildings in Elk Grove Village, in Cook and DuPage counties, typical of the 10,000 to 100,000 SF segment.

image:image.image:title: Aerial view of rows of single-story industrial and warehouse buildings with truck courts and parking in Elk Grove Village, Illinois.
image:image.image:caption: Industrial buildings in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. Regional illustration, not a listing or a transaction attributed to Pavlo Rospopa.

image:image.image:title: Rows of container chassis and stacked intermodal containers at the BNSF rail terminal in Cicero, Illinois, under an overcast sky.
image:image.image:caption: BNSF intermodal terminal in Cicero, Cook County. Freight infrastructure shapes demand, but a building’s own access still has to be verified.

image:image.image:title: Loading dock of a warehouse with a shipping container on a chassis and a trailer backed up to dock doors.
image:image.image:caption: Dock positions, levelers, and trailer staging are lease terms as much as building features. Confirm who may use them and when.

image:image.image:title: The downtown Chicago skyline seen across the lakefront, with Willis Tower rising above the Loop.
image:image.image:caption: Chicago’s Loop from the lakefront. City records cover the city; suburban and unincorporated parcels have their own authorities.
